An outlaw (Henry Fonda) working for a railroad magnate fights a stranger (Charles Bronson) for a New Orleans widow's (Claudia Cardinale) land.

programme.title: To Catch a Thief

programme.desc: After returning to Hawaii from being in the army, a pineapple tycoon's rebellious son turns into an island tour guide with his girlfriend.
programme.title: Blue Hawaii

programme.desc: A drifter (John Garfield) stops at a Greek diner and helps the owner's (Cecil Kellaway) lusty wife (Lana Turner) become a widow.
programme.title: The Postman Always Rings Twice

programme.desc: An American secret agent tries to retrieve a roll of microfilm in South Africa before it falls into communist hands.
programme.title: The Cape Town Affair

programme.desc: A couple (Dick Van Dyke, Debbie Reynolds) break up after 15 years of marriage, then get back together as the easy way out.
programme.title: Divorce American Style

programme.title: White Comanche

programme.desc: A French diplomat (Jean-Pierre Aumont) falls for a recent graduate (Ginger Rogers) of a Paris school for pickpockets.
programme.title: Heartbeat

programme.desc: A stewardess (Doris Day) runs for her life once she realizes her second husband (Louis Jourdan) killed her first.
programme.title: Julie

programme.title: The Autobiography of Miss Jane Pittman

programme.desc: A poor but hopeful boy seeks one of the five coveted golden tickets that will send him on a tour of Willy Wonka's mysterious chocolate factory.
programme.title: Willy Wonka and the Chocolate Factory

programme.desc: Two vaudeville flops (Bing Crosby, Bob Hope) pose as bad guys and join the Klondike gold rush with a saloon singer (Dorothy Lamour).
programme.title: Road to Utopia

programme.desc: A small-town Mississippi boss tries to pair his daughter (Joanne Woodward) with an enigmatic drifter (Paul Newman).
programme.title: The Long, Hot Summer

programme.desc: A secret agent (Dean Martin) stops a Chinese villain's atomic plot in the first of four Matt Helm movies.
programme.title: The Silencers

programme.desc: An agent (Tom Ewell) turns the girlfriend (Jayne Mansfield) of a former gangster (Edmond O'Brien) into a rock 'n' roll star.
programme.title: The Girl Can't Help It

programme.desc: A space scientist (Hugh Marlowe) figures out how to down a fleet of alien spacecraft looming over Washington, D.C.
programme.title: Earth vs. the Flying Saucers

programme.desc: The Southerner (Gene Tierney) and her husband (Randolph Scott) are still fighting the Civil War, chased by a Union major (Dana Andrews) smitten with Belle.
programme.title: Belle Starr

programme.desc: An outlaw (John Wayne), a prostitute (Claire Trevor), a drunken doctor and assorted others go through Indian country.
programme.title: Stagecoach

programme.desc: Americans (Mark Stevens, Patric Knowles) try to smuggle gold from France to use against the British in the War of 1812.
programme.title: Mutiny

programme.desc: The outlaw (Wendell Corey) tries to kill an insurance agent (Bob Hope) who has been mistaken for him in order to collect on a big policy.
programme.title: Alias Jesse James

programme.desc: The mythical Greek hero (Reg Park) rescues a maiden left at the mercy of a beast and goes on to save his son from the sexist queen of lost Atlantis (Fay Spain).
programme.title: Hercules and the Captive Women

programme.desc: A music professor (Ryan O'Neal) visits San Francisco with his fiancée (Madeline Kahn) and meets a kooky woman (Barbra Streisand).
programme.title: What's Up, Doc?

programme.desc: A time-warped astronaut (James Franciscus) lands on ape-ruled Earth and finds telepathic mutants worshiping an atomic bomb.
programme.title: Beneath the Planet of the Apes

programme.desc: The arrival of wealthy bachelors in town causes an uproar when families with single daughters aggressively seek engagements, including the Bennet family, with five eligible daughters.
programme.title: Pride and Prejudice

programme.desc: A suave stranger (Cary Grant) helps a chic widow (Audrey Hepburn) stalked by four men looking for loot in Paris.
programme.title: Charade

programme.desc: A cartoonist (Dean Martin) turns his babbling roommate's (Jerry Lewis) bizarre dreams into a hit comic strip read by spies.
programme.title: Artists and Models

programme.desc: New York playgirl Holly Golightly puzzles a writer who lives in her building.

programme.desc: People pester an old, dying gunfighter (John Wayne) rooming with a widow (Lauren Bacall) in 1901 Nevada.
programme.title: The Shootist

programme.desc: Banned from racing, a brash young driver (Mickey Rooney) returns to Indianapolis and burns up the track.
programme.title: The Big Wheel

programme.desc: Count Alucard comes out of a lake in his coffin and makes a Southern belle his bride.
programme.title: Son of Dracula

programme.title: Where the Hell's That Gold?
